**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.event.impl.node` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [NodeDragEvent.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/event/impl/node/NodeDragEvent.java)

The event of `beforeDragStart` and `beforeDragDrop`, which can refuse the start or the drop of a drag.

## Description

A refused start leaves the node in place; a refused drop sends it back to where the drag started.

## Learn more

- [Drag and drop](/use/learn/interactivity/drag-and-drop/#drop-on-a-target)
